title: Enterprise Churn — Answered
summary: A question, not a decision. The answer already exists in the data.
shortRequest: What was our enterprise customer churn rate last month?
request: What was our enterprise customer churn rate last month?

intro.headline: Meetings are not the problem.
lines: Some requests are not decisions at all. They are questions with six calendars attached.
6 people. 30 minutes. To read a number one system already holds.
SYNCLESS answers those before anyone opens a calendar.

before.verdict: A meeting to read a number that Customer Analytics reports on demand.
before.note: The problem is not the 30 minutes. The problem is that nobody checked whether the answer already existed.

analysis.headline: The answer already exists in the company's data. No human judgement is required, so no human needs to be synchronized.
reasoning: The request asks for a fact that Customer Analytics reports on demand — nothing here is a judgement call.
No decision is being made, so no accountable owner is required.
Information sufficiency is 98%: all three supporting systems agree.
6 participants × 30 minutes of blended synchronous time would cost NT$2,700.
SYNCLESS answers directly and cites the source, so the number can be checked rather than debated.
analysis.cost_basis: 6 participants × 0.5 h × NT$900 blended hourly = NT$2,700

questions.question: What was enterprise churn last month?
How many enterprise accounts were active in the period?

decision.title: Enterprise Churn — Answered
decision.recommendation: Enterprise churn was 4.2% in August 2026, down from 4.8% in July, across 214 active enterprise accounts. Answered directly from Customer Analytics with the source attached — no meeting, no owner, no coordination.
post_approval: Answer returned with its source attached
Logged so the next person asking gets it instantly
The 6-person review meeting was never created
